response.sql: WITH oc AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a FROM oc), above AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.cnt FROM oc, avg_all WHERE oc.cnt > avg_all.a), avg_above AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS b FROM above) SELECT above.account_id, above.cnt AS order_count, above.cnt - avg_all.a AS diff_above_overall_avg, above.cnt - avg_above.b AS diff_above_avg_of_above FROM above, avg_all, avg_above ORDER BY diff_above_avg_of_above DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average number of orders per account is computed only over accounts that have at least one order (accounts without orders are excluded), as the request says 'each account with standing orders'.
Ties at the 10th position are broken arbitrarily by LIMIT 10.
